title: Morning Brief, Fri 13 Nov 2026: PM Modi says diesel rose only ₹7 a litre when at least ₹50 was needed and the Centre bore the other ₹43 (Kisan Tak Bharat Agriculture Conference, New Delhi, Thu 12 Nov; crude $70 to $122 within weeks, about ₹14,000 crore a month, per the PM) (lead); Sonam Wangchuk says he is under house arrest in Leh, police say he was advised to stay home under election-period prohibitory orders (LAHDC polls 4 Dec); Owaisi (AIMIM) and Chandra Shekhar Aazad (ASP-KR) announce the Samajik Parivartan Morcha in Lucknow, Aazad its CM candidate for UP 2027, open to SP and Congress joining; two SPOs missing on patrol in Kishtwar found dead with bullet wounds, service weapons reportedly missing; Putin meets Witkoff and Kushner for 4+ hours, 'only one line of demarcation: the state border', foreign peacekeepers a 'legitimate target', Kostiantynivka humanitarian mission proposed; Kushner says no deal without Europeans at the table, Kremlin has not confirmed
